decisionsTitle: The sponsor list as Excel with every tick beside it, «Doar cu oferte și beneficii» on the registrations list, and the public-list tick in the export (amending §570)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-30 11:10:** «cum pot exporta participanții, doar cei care au bifat că vor datele publicate pentru parteneri? trebuie să am Excel cu toate bifele lor». §570 gave him a CSV of five columns behind «Descarcă lista pentru sponsori»; the full export (`workbook.ts`) carried most ticks as columns but the club had to filter by hand, and the public-list tick itself had no column at all. **Amends §570** (the sponsor list's one file) and §425/§500 (the export's consent columns).

**The sponsor list, also as Excel.** One form, two submits beside «Cui dai lista (opțional)»: «Descarcă lista pentru sponsori (Excel)» (the handshake glyph, `format=xlsx`) and «Descarcă CSV» (the download glyph, `format=csv`, the default for any other value — `sponsorListFormat`). The same route, the same `sponsorList` read and therefore **the same rows** — §570's sharing rule unchanged: a yes given under a notice that names `{{promotionalMaterialsShared}}` in every language (both the recorded notice and the one in force at the yes), an adult on the day of the download, a real registration whose address is proved and which still stands; never a minor, a cancelled, an expired or a test registration. The Excel file is written by the start list's own writer — `workbook.ts#writeSheet`, now shared by both sheets: a bold frozen header, the club's clock and date format (§439), every text a text cell so a name is never a formula — one sheet «Sponsori» (“Sponsors” for an English reader), named `sponsori-<slug>-<zi>.xlsx` (`sponsori-toate-<zi>.xlsx` on «Newsletter»). Its columns (`sponsor-sheet.ts#SPONSOR_SHEET_COLUMNS`), headed in the reader's language: the CSV's five first, in its order — Prenume, Nume, Email, Eveniment, then the offers' moment headed «Oferte și beneficii (data acordului)», since here it stands among other consents — then «Nota de confidențialitate (versiunea)» the yes was given under (the notice in force at `promo_consent_at`, `noticeVersionInForceAt`; for a tick on the form the one the registration records), «Lista publică & rezultate» (Da/Nu, `list_opt_out` false), «Rețele pe lista publică» (Da/Nu, `list_socials`), «Termeni (versiunea)» and «Termeni (acceptați la)» (§421, §425), «Declarația (versiunea)» and «Declarația (semnată la)» (the latest acceptance, `listLatestDeclarationAcceptances`, §499) and «Starea înscrierii» in words. A blank version or moment is a cell not written, never 0. Never the birth date, the phone, the identity document, the health note or the address holder's other people. Both files write the same audit row, `registrations.sponsor_list_exported`, now with `format` (`csv` | `xlsx`) beside the event, the count, the recipient and the registrations' ids — so «Dată partenerilor» on a registration's page lists either download. The role gate is §570's (`canExportSponsorList`: the Organizer, the Administrator, the Superadministrator; Tehnic, the volunteer and the Redactor 403) and the notice gate too (409 while the notice in force does not describe the sharing).

**Which file goes to a partner.** A second caption under the button: «Excelul are în plus toate bifele fiecăruia, ca să vezi la ce și-a dat acordul. Partenerului dă-i CSV-ul.» The notice tells the person that a partner receives «prenumele, numele și adresa ta de e-mail» (§570's `{{promotionalMaterialsShared}}`); the terms and declaration versions, the list ticks and the state are the club's own check of who agreed to what, not data a partner needs (art. 5(1)(c) GDPR, the minimisation §570 argued). The application cannot see what the club does with a file after the download, so it says it where the button is; the audit row records which format left.

**«Doar cu oferte și beneficii» on the registrations list.** A box beside the existing filters, in the same GET form (`promo=1`), with the offers box's own megaphone glyph (§570 round 2) as its label's first, `aria-hidden` child through `CheckboxField`'s `dense` layout (44 by 44 to the thumb) and one caption: «Cei care au bifat „oferte și beneficii”, cu înscrierea încă valabilă. Exportul ia același filtru.» It narrows the list, its count and its status strip by **§570's one condition** — `sponsor-list.ts#promoListed()`, the read of the club's list on «Newsletter» and of the sponsor list's candidates, now also `registrationConditions`' `promoConsented`: a yes on a real registration in `PENDING_DECLARATION`, `WAITLISTED`, `WAITLIST_OFFERED` or `CONFIRMED` — one truth for who consented. It rides with every sort, page and export link (`listParams`), so «Exportă Excel» and «Exportă CSV» beside the list write exactly the rows on screen, the export route reading `promo` like the others; the fold opens while it is on. The list shows every yes — a yes given under the older notice included, since the club's own sending covers it (§562); only the sponsor file narrows further, and says so in its caption. It is a view, not a permission: whoever reads the list (the Organizer, the Administrator) may use it.

**The full export names the public-list tick.** «Public list & results» (“Yes” or empty in the CSV, a boolean cell in the spreadsheet) right after «Socials on the public list» in both files — `!list_opt_out`, the tick «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» (§143, §570) that the socials column depends on. Beside it rather than last, because the owner asked for it there and the spreadsheet is matched by header; a CSV script reading by position after «Socials on the public list» sees one column more.

**No migration and no dependency:** every value is on the rows already, and `write-excel-file` is the writer §172 chose.

**Refused.** Adding the sponsor columns to the partner's CSV (the notice names three data; §570's minimisation stands). A second query of who consented for the list's filter — it reads `promoListed`, the same condition. A filter narrowed to the sponsor rule (the notice versions and the age): that rule needs the approved notices and each birth date against today, and the club's own list is every yes; the sponsor file's count stays beside its button. Dropping the CSV: a script and a partner still want five plain columns. Raw status codes in the sponsor sheet: its headers are in the reader's language, so its states are too.

**Tests.** Unit (`sponsor-sheet.test.ts`, a new `tests/helpers/xlsx.ts` reading the sheet's XML): the thirteen headers in order in both languages, no birth date, phone or document header; one sheet «Sponsori»; per row Da/Nu, versions as numbers, moments on the club's clock, blanks not written, the state in words; English words; no formula; an empty list still a file; `sponsori-<event>-<day>.xlsx` and `sponsorListFormat`; «Public list & results» after the socials in the CSV and the sheet. Integration on PGlite (`sponsor-list.test.ts`): the Excel file and the CSV hold the same rows, a yes under §562's notice, a minor and a no in neither; each tick's value per row (a ticked list and socials with terms v3 and declaration v5; an unticked one with nothing signed); the audit rows name `csv` and `xlsx` and both reach «Dată partenerilor»; English words; the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator 200, Tehnic, the volunteer and the Redactor 403, 409 without a sharing notice; the list filter returns exactly `promoListed`'s rows (the older notice's yes on screen, a no, a cancelled and a test row not), and the CSV and the Excel export with `promo=1` hold the same rows, «Public list & results» after the socials. The e2e spec `promo-filter.spec.ts` (written, not run: CI runs it on the batch): the box with its glyph at 44 px narrows the list, stays ticked, and both export links carry `promo=1`.
changelogLine: - **The sponsor list as Excel, with every tick** — «Descarcă lista pentru sponsori (Excel)» gives the same people as the CSV in one sheet «Sponsori», each consent in its own column (offers and benefits with its notice, the public list & results, the socials, the terms, the declaration, the state); the CSV stays beside it for a partner; a box «Doar cu oferte și beneficii» on the registrations list shows who said yes, and the export follows it; the full export gains «Public list & results». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given registrations on the sponsor list, when «Descarcă lista pentru sponsori (Excel)» is downloaded (`GET /api/admin/registrations/sponsor-list?format=xlsx`, for one event or every event), then it holds exactly the rows of the CSV of the same moment — a yes given under a notice that describes the sharing, of an adult, on a real registration that still stands, never a yes under an older notice, a minor, a no, a cancelled, an expired or a test registration — in one sheet «Sponsori» named `sponsori-<slug>-<day>.xlsx` or `sponsori-toate-<day>.xlsx`, with the CSV's five columns first and then the notice the yes was given under, the public list & results and the socials (yes or no), the terms' and the declaration's versions and moments and the registration's state, headed in the reader's language, a blank version or moment left unwritten, and never the birth date, the phone, the identity document or the health note (2026-09-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a download of the sponsor list in either format, when it is served, then it writes one audit row `registrations.sponsor_list_exported` naming its `format` (`csv` or `xlsx`) beside the event, the count, the recipient and the registrations' ids, and a registration in it lists that download under «Dată partenerilor» (2026-09-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the registrations list with «Doar cu oferte și beneficii» ticked (`promo=1`), when it renders and when «Exportă Excel» or «Exportă CSV» beside it is followed, then the list, its count and both files hold exactly the registrations `promoListed` names — a yes to offers and benefits on a real registration waiting for its declaration, on the waiting list, offered a place or confirmed — and no other; and the full export carries «Public list & results» (the public-list tick) right after «Socials on the public list» in the CSV and the spreadsheet (2026-09-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the sponsor list as an Excel file, when its route is asked, then the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator receive it, Tehnic, a volunteer and the Redactor are refused on the server (403) and no audit row is written for them, and while the notice in force does not describe the sharing it is refused (409) (2026-09-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the sponsor list as Excel with every tick, a «Doar cu oferte și beneficii» filter on the registrations list, and the public-list tick in the export
